property_summary: For every caller and every uint256 index, calling NETM() must not alter the token balance at that index, because the reference NETM() reverts for non-owner callers while the mutant lets anyone overwrite owner and balances, so the rule 'balances(k) stays at its pre-call value for all k' breaks on the mutant when the caller is not the original owner.
change_summary: Delete the owner check in onlyOwner so owner-only functions become callable by anyone.
